sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Deal magic damage (Dark) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces physical and magic Ability Power by 40 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Abstraction for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Envy Collapse (blocks max HP increase effects, increases Ability Power of damage taken by 30, increases cooldown by 30%, and increases Ability Cost consumption by 100%) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Removes 50 Cost.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Water and Dark Defense from Unison Damage +500
